title: VacationResponse non_exhaustive without constructor
description: VacationResponse is #[non_exhaustive] (vacation.rs line 13) but has no constructor fn and no Default impl. Users outside the crate cannot construct it for test fixtures or mocks. Since VacationResponse fields are fully spec-defined (they will not grow), #[non_exhaustive] adds pain without benefit. Either add a constructor fn, remove #[non_exhaustive], or document that external construction is intentionally blocked (VacationResponse is server-set, read via /get only).
